To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the human interleukin 2 receptor gene can be transfected into mouse L929 cells and that the abnormal expression of the gene in some T-cell leukemia cells is due to gene rearrangement.
we have demonstrated the expression of human IL-2R cDNA in mouse L929 cells and that this expression is associated with the binding of IL-2 and the anti-Tac antibody.
the product of hIL-2R cDNA in L cells is able to specifically bind IL-2, anti-Tac antibody and that hIL-2 receptor c DNA was successfully expressed in T-cell leukemia cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of human IL-2R cDNA in L cells and the abnormal expression of this gene in T-cell leukemias.
the expression of IL- 2R in mammalian cells and the abnormal expression of the gene in T-cell leukemic cells.
the expression of the human interleukin receptor gene in L929 cells and the abnormal expression of the gene in human T-cell leukemia cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the abnormal expression of the IL-2R in Jukat cells is due to the amplification of the gene, whereas in Molt-4 it is the consequence of gene rearrangement.
the expression of IL- 2R gene in L929 cells was successful and the product of IL-2 R gene in Jukat and Molt- 4 cells was abnormal.
the expression of IL- 2R gene in mammalian cells is a feasible approach for the study of human T-cell leukemia.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of IL- 2R gene can be detected in a variety of mammalian cells.

1, IL-2R cDNA could be expressed in mouse cells; 2, IL-2 could bind the expressed IL-2R and induce the growth of L929 cells; 3, the abnormal expression and overproduction of IL-2 in T-cell leukemia cells might be one of the important factors in the proliferation of these cells.
the expression of human IL-2R in mammalian cells can be obtained by transfection of human IL-1R cDNA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IL-2R is overexpressed on T-cell leukemia cell line.
the IL-2R cDNA can be expressed in L929 cells and the product can bind IL-2.
IL-2R expression in L929 cells can be detected by using the FITC-IL2 fluorescent staining assay.
